name: West Lafayette Parks and Recreation lifeguards
org: City of West Lafayette Parks and Recreation
what_you_do: Work as a lifeguard at the city's indoor pool at the John R. Dennis Wellness Center or the outdoor Municipal Pool. The city also runs the lifeguard certification class.
who_can_apply: You must be 15 by the last day of the lifeguard class. You also do 6 to 8 hours of work online first. Then you must pass a swim test on the first night.
pay_detail: Paid city job. The rate is not stated on the page.
duration: Flexible scheduling; the certification class is a 4-day block
deadline_text: The city says it is always hiring lifeguards. Certification classes are scheduled based on interest.
how_to_apply: If you already have your lifeguard card, apply on the city job site. If not, email Julie Martin, who runs the pools, to get into a class: jamartin@westlafayette.in.gov.
notes: You must go to all four class days to pass. The swim test is a 150-yard swim, a 2-minute tread, a 50-yard swim and a timed dive for an object. The page does not list the class cost or pay, so ask. Wellness Center: 765-269-4950.
